lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible across the lateral flank. The spots are arranged in a regular grid-like pattern with two to four centroids per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming distinct grid-like nodes across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower-left foreground contains a dense population of small, high-intensity circular spots that are significantly smaller than the primary flank spots.
